# SFL Audio & Lighting

> Adelaide-based provider of professional audio, lighting and audiovisual solutions. SFL designs, installs and configures custom systems for hospitality venues, entertainment spaces, commercial premises and private projects.

Professional audio. Intelligent lighting. Seamless integration. Designed for your space. Engineered for performance.

From powerful nightclub sound systems and multi-zone audio distribution to intelligent lighting control and complete AV integration, SFL brings technology together to create reliable, high-performance environments. Whether a client is upgrading an existing installation or starting from scratch, SFL develops a solution tailored to their space, operational needs and budget.

- Location: Adelaide, South Australia, Australia
- Clients: bars, clubs, pubs, restaurants, hospitality venues, entertainment spaces, commercial premises, private projects
- Website: https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/

## Services

- [Commercial Audio Installations](https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/#services): Custom sound systems for bars, clubs, restaurants and commercial spaces. From background music to high-output entertainment systems, designed around the acoustic and operational requirements of the venue.
- [Lighting Design & Installation](https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/#services): Intelligent lighting, architectural illumination, DMX control and automated lighting solutions that transform spaces and create memorable environments.
- [Audio Processing & System Integration](https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/#services): Advanced signal routing, digital signal processing (DSP), multi-zone audio, system tuning and centralised control, connecting equipment into one cohesive, manageable system.
- [DJ Booth & Entertainment Systems](https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/#services): Custom DJ booth integrations, professional audio connectivity, booth monitoring and flexible signal routing for demanding entertainment environments.
- [System Upgrades & Optimisation](https://kianmohr.github.io/SFLAudio/#services): Assessment of existing audio and lighting installations that aren't performing as they should, troubleshooting technical issues and recommending practical improvements to performance, reliability and usability.

## How a project works

1. Consultation: understanding the space, requirements and goals; identifying challenges and opportunities for a new installation or an upgrade.
2. System Design: a tailored solution covering equipment selection, system layout, signal distribution, control requirements and future expandability.
3. Proposal & Quotation: a clear proposal outlining the recommended solution, project scope and estimated costs.
4. Installation & Integration: installation, equipment configuration, signal routing and integration with existing infrastructure.
5. Testing & Optimisation: configuring and testing the system, fine-tuning performance, and ensuring controls and functionality meet operational requirements.
6. Handover & Support: explaining how to operate the new system and guidance on maintaining reliable performance.
